description: This file defines the BlogApiController class, which provides API endpoints for managing blog posts, tags, images, and post properties within the Goteo project. It includes methods for listing posts, retrieving tags, uploading images, deleting images, setting default images, and updating post properties.

classes.name: BlogApiController
classes.description: Controller class providing API endpoints for blog post management, image handling, and property updates in the Goteo project.

methods.name: validatePost
methods.description: Validates a blog post by slug, checking user permissions and publication status.

methods.name: postsAction
methods.description: Returns a JSON list of blog posts, supporting filtering, pagination, and search.

methods.name: tagsAction
methods.description: Returns a JSON list of all blog tags for suggestion purposes.

methods.name: uploadImagesAction
methods.description: Handles AJAX image uploads for the blog, with permission checks.

methods.name: deleteImagesAction
methods.description: Deletes a specified image from a blog post.

methods.name: postDefaultImagesAction
methods.description: Sets a default image for a blog post within its galleries.

methods.name: postPropertyAction
methods.description: Updates a specific property of a blog post via PUT request, with permission checks.
